commentary: lovedogs liked this option (#25/#27), and Karl_K saw potential (#28). 0-0-0 instead noted leakage on tilt (#29), describing under-table steps that fail to flash and stronger-tilt through-view (#32). The supplied v360.diamonds URL is not proof of a locally recoverable v360.in frame sequence.
